purpose: Define the minimum verified IR required by the Stage1 general emitter without source rereading, semantic reconstruction from source, or code-generation delegation.

observed_self_source.locals_note: Historical native count only; fresh candidate lexical/native reconciliation is mandatory before local capacity selection.

rules: Do not truncate any event, semantic value, call, argument, parameter, local, block, instruction, or terminator representation.
Do not select a large arbitrary capacity. Record the pre-change count, exact candidate delta, selected bounded capacity, and post-change native count.
Every capacity remains fail-closed and verifier checked.
The call-argument pool remains 746 only while the exact transformed candidate fits the independently validated call-argument model and subsequent native measurement.
Static zero-initializer counts are never treated as semantic value headroom without a separately qualified transform.

representation_rules.parameter: Packed bounded record; current candidate uses one i64[64] lane.
representation_rules.local: Packed bounded shape-preserving record; scalar versus fixed-array kind and extent are semantic. Physical byte/frame offset is emitter-owned and is not frozen in IR.
representation_rules.instruction_owner: Do not duplicate owner_function_id in every instruction. Derive owner through instruction.block_id -> packed block.owner_function_id.
representation_rules.instruction_storage: Candidate reuses the four legacy event banks only after the legacy event verifier and only after native IR-v2 verification proves the in-place rewrite.
representation_rules.call_result: Do not add a duplicate call-result array. The call-producing instruction owns result_value_id; call metadata supplies callee/flags/arguments.
representation_rules.terminator: Packed block/terminator record owns kind, targets, condition and return value linkage.
representation_rules.value_storage: Legacy ir_value_records_0..3 are structural numeric-token records and must not be silently reinterpreted as a semantic namespace. Explicit rebuild/rebase is mandatory.

identity_rules.parameter_ids: stable deterministic function-signature order in fixed semantic domain [0,64)
identity_rules.local_ids: stable deterministic declaration order; current candidate rule is 64 + global local-record index
identity_rules.value_ids: single non-colliding namespace for parameters, locals, constants and instruction results
identity_rules.physical_layout: not part of semantic local identity

required_def_use: A parameter reference resolves to its parameter semantic value ID.
A local read resolves to the local semantic/storage identity and the currently defined value required by bootstrap lowering.
A local store records destination local identity and source value ID.
Arithmetic and comparison instructions record operand value IDs and result value ID.
Calls consume ordered argument value IDs from the existing bounded argument pool and expose result_value_id through the producing instruction when consumed.
Discard preserves the side-effecting instruction; it is not a second semantic instruction by itself.
Conditional terminators record condition value ID and verified block targets.
Return terminators record the returned value ID rather than an aggregate/literal-only lane.

emitter_boundary.unsupported_shape_behavior: fail closed with a specific emitter diagnostic

verifier_minimum: all parameter/local owners exist and match function ownership
local storage kind/extent/ordinal invariants are valid
each instruction belongs to exactly one valid block and derives exactly one valid owner through that block
all operand/result semantic value IDs are defined and owned compatibly
call argument ranges are within the bounded banked argument pool
call-producing instruction/result linkage is valid when a result exists
terminator condition/return IDs are valid when required
all branch targets are valid blocks owned by the same function
no silent overflow, truncation, namespace collision or raw-source reconstruction
